name: void_bolt_impact
for: void_stalker void bolt: hit (hero or shield)
notes: A collapse, not a burst: the hole swells while broken lens arcs and violet streaks are dragged spiralling into it (frames 1-5), it crushes to a white pinpoint (6), then space snaps back in three broken violet arcs, dark violet shards fly and fall and motes blink out. Anchor = hit point. 12 frames @12 fps; the damage reads best on frame 6-7.
